notes: Menus and tooltips open out of the spot they belong to, and buttons dip a little when you press them.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
Turn on Traffic in the menu to see how much your PC downloaded and uploaded this week, this month and in the 3 months before.
The numbers come from Windows, so they count while Tavora is closed too.
The Connection section says how your connection is for playing: Smooth, Laggy or Unstable, and how long it has run without a drop.
All four connection cards fit in one row, and the drops list only shows once there is a drop.
New Connection section: see if you're online, your ping to the router and the internet, lost pings and the speed of your network.
Drops in your connection are listed with the time and how long they lasted, even when the panel was closed. Needs Tavora 0.21.22.
See which apps use your memory: the new button on the Memory card lists them with their RAM and CPU.
Your NVIDIA graphics card now shows its temperature and power use.
See how busy your CPU, graphics card, memory and drives are.
Pick which drives to watch and how often it updates.
